# Teach Starter

> > Teach Starter provides elementary teachers with thousands of curriculum-aligned teaching resources, lesson plans, printables, and classroom activities across all major subject areas and grade levels.

Teach Starter is a comprehensive resource platform for US elementary school teachers (Pre-K through Grade 7) offering lesson plans, worksheets, games, and classroom materials. The platform organizes content by subject area (ELA, Math, Science, Social Studies, Health, Fine Arts, Languages, and SEL) and grade level, with flexible subscription plans for classroom access.

## Key Topics

- Elementary Education
- Lesson Planning
- Teaching Materials
- Classroom Activities
- Printable Worksheets
- Social-Emotional Learning
- Curriculum-Aligned Resources
- Google Slides
- Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Sheets)
- Grade Levels (Pre-K through Grade 7)
- Subject Areas (ELA, Math, Science, Social Studies)
- Holiday Lessons
- Teacher Tools
- Center Activities
- Dolch Sight Words

## Getting Started

- [Elementary School Teaching Resources - US](https://www.teachstarter.com): Teach Starter homepage offering elementary teaching resources, lesson plans, and classroom activities.
- [US Region Portal](https://www.teachstarter.com/us): US region landing page for Teach Starter elementary teaching resources and materials.
- [Subscription Plans](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/plans): Teach Starter pricing plans and subscription tiers for teacher resource access.

## Resource Library

- [Teaching Resources](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/teaching-resources): Teaching resources library with printables, games, activities and worksheets.
- [Learning Areas](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/learning-areas): Browse teaching resources by 8 curriculum subject categories and learning areas.
- [Grade Levels](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/grade-levels): Browse teaching resources by 9 grade level categories from Pre-K to Grade 7.

## Subject Area Resources

- [English Language Arts Teaching Resources](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/learning-area/elar-us): ELA teaching resources including worksheets, games, and lesson plans for K-5.
- [Math Teaching Resources](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/learning-area/mathematics-us): Elementary math teaching resources with worksheets, games, and lesson plans.
- [Science Teaching Resources](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/learning-area/science-us): Science teaching resources including STEM activities and inquiry-based lessons.
- [Social Studies Teaching Resources](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/learning-area/social-studies-us): Social studies resources covering US history and world history for K-7.
- [Social Emotional Learning Teaching Resources](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/learning-area/social-emotional-learning-us): SEL teaching resources with activities, worksheets, and emotion regulation tools.
- [Health Education Teaching Resources](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/learning-area/health-us): Health education resources with posters, worksheets, and safety lessons.
- [Special Areas Teaching Resources](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/learning-area/fine-arts-us): Fine arts and special areas resources for music, art, and technology.
- [Languages (Other Than English) Teaching Resources](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/learning-area/languages-other-than-american-english): LOTE resources including Spanish, German, and bilingual classroom materials.

## Grade-Level Resources

- [Pre-K Teaching Resources](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/grade-level/pre-kindergarten): Pre-kindergarten teaching resources for early childhood education and phonics.
- [Kindergarten Teaching Resources](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/grade-level/kindergarten): Kindergarten resources with literacy, math, and social-emotional learning materials.
- [1st Grade Teaching Resources](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/grade-level/grade-1): 1st-grade resources including sight words, phonics, math, and classroom materials.
- [2nd Grade Teaching Resources](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/grade-level/grade-2): 2nd-grade teaching materials with math worksheets, spelling, and activities.
- [3rd Grade Teaching Resources](https://www.teachstarter.com/us/grade-level/grade-3): 3rd-grade resources including math, spelling, games, and classroom activities.
